$description: Choices and status: checkbox and radio (group check), switch, slider, progress, badge and spinner. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (approved on the review board, F-D072 to F-D075), first shown in round 7. Component tokens, merged into the --ui-* layer by node tools/tokens/build.mjs. Every colour is a palette primitive or an existing role. Ink decides: checked, on, the slider's range and the progress fill are Ink, never Amber. Group check is the checkbox control (--ui-check-*), not the Amber Quality Gate check (--ui-check).

size.description: The checkbox and the radio: a 20 px box, centred in a 44 px hit area (size.hit).

bg.description: Unchecked checkbox and radio: white, like an input, with the edge below.

edge.description: The hairline of an unchecked box or circle: Ink at 48 %, 3.2:1 on white and 3.0:1 against a card, so the 20 px control passes the 3:1 for UI parts. Lighter hairlines (Border, Focus 300) vanish at this size. One of the few strokes the system allows: without it the box disappears.

edge-hover.description: Hover: the edge comes one step toward Ink.

on.description: Checked, indeterminate and selected: Ink. Never Amber.

on-hover.description: Checked under the pointer: Ink lifts one step, like the primary button.

mark.description: The check, the dash and the radio's centre on Ink: Porcelain, 17.9:1.

ring.description: A selected radio: the edge thickens into a 6 px Ink ring around an 8 px Porcelain centre.

disabled.description: Disabled box or circle, checked or not: the sunken disabled surface, no edge.

disabled-mark.description: The check, dash or centre on a disabled control.

width.description: Default switch track: 40 x 24, a pill. The hit area is 44 either way.

thumb.description: The white thumb, 2 px inside the track.

width-sm.description: Small switch, for dense rows and glass: 32 x 20.

stretch.description: Pressed: the thumb stretches 4 px toward where it will go, the moment the finger lands.

track.description: Off: the sunken surface. The white thumb, lifted by depth, carries the shape.

track-hover.description: Off under the pointer: one step toward Ink.

track-on-hover.description: On under the pointer: Ink lifts one step.

track-on-disabled.description: On and disabled: Ink falls back to Focus 300, so on and off stay apart without looking active.

thumb-bg.description: The thumb: white, lifted with depth.raised instead of an edge.

glass-track.description: Off on glass: a Porcelain veil, a little stronger than the clear button's so the track reads at 20 px.

glass-track-hover.description: Off on glass under the pointer: the veil lifts one step.

glass-track-on.description: On on glass: the white of the main glass button. The thumb turns Ink, so on reads at a glance over any photo.

glass-thumb.description: The thumb on glass when off. No shadow on glass.

glass-thumb-on.description: The thumb on glass when on: Ink on white.

thumb.description: The white thumb, lifted with depth.raised; its hit area is 44.

range.description: The chosen range: Ink. Never Amber.

range-disabled.description: The range on a disabled slider.

glass-track.description: The track on glass: a Porcelain veil.

glass-range.description: The range and the thumb on glass: Porcelain. No shadow on glass.

height.description: A thin pill track, the same weight as the slider's.

fill.description: Ink. Never Amber: progress is work under way, Amber is work checked.

sweep.description: 1800 ms: one pass of the indeterminate bar, two spinner turns.

glass-track.description: The track on glass: a Porcelain veil.

height.description: A badge: a 24 px pill with 12 px label text and 12 px air at the ends.

height-sm.description: Counts beside a label or in a row.

dot.description: The status dot beside a badge label, and the dot on an icon.

hover.description: A neutral badge that is a link or a button, under the pointer: one step toward Ink from the sunken surface.

pressed.description: The same badge pressed: two steps, with the 3 % shrink.

size-xl.description: The display spinner, for a page or a panel that is loading. Controls use the icon sizes (14, 16, 18).
